components.name: Manual Section
components.description: Bold caps head hung in an 11rem margin, body at 68ch beside it; collapses to head-over-indented-body below 45rem.
components.html:
DESCRIPTION

Shiru turns the MDX in your repository into a documentation site, and serves every page twice: typeset for people, and as plain Markdown for agents. Read /index.md.
components.css: .ds-section{display:grid;grid-template-columns:11rem minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:2.5rem;align-items:baseline;font:400 1.1875rem/1.6 var(--font-serif, "STIX Two Text", "Times New Roman", Times, serif);color:var(--color-ink, #1a1a1a);} .ds-section h2{grid-column:1;margin:0;font-size:1em;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.02em;color:var(--color-ink-strong, #000000);} .ds-section p{grid-column:2;margin:0;max-width:68ch;} .ds-section a{color:var(--color-link, #1f4fbf);text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:0.18em;} .ds-section a:hover{text-decoration-thickness:2px;} @media (max-width:45rem){.ds-section{display:block;} .ds-section p{margin:0.5rem 0 0 1.5rem;}}

narrative.overview:
shiru.sh is SHIRU(1): one source, typeset for people and plain for agents, the way troff and nroff render one man page twice. The page is white manual paper with black ink and a single manual blue for links. A mono header line and footer line frame it like a printed manual. Section names hang in a left margin in bold caps, and their bodies sit in a hanging indent beside them. Everything else is running text, command lines and example blocks.

Density is a reference document's density: one long column with a fixed measure, generous section breaks and no decorative furniture. Hierarchy comes from the margin, weight and the move between serif and mono, not from size steps, colour fields or containers. The only large type on the page is the NAME line. Dark mode is the same page on a terminal: the tokens invert and nothing else changes.

The page can re-set itself. A view switch on the header rule crossfades the typeset article into its own Markdown source, which is the same string served at `/index.md`. Every new surface in this world has to survive that test: it must still make sense as plain Markdown.
keyCharacteristics: Paper, ink and one blue. No other hues.
STIX Two Text for the typeset view, Courier Prime for commands, code, source and the frame lines.
Bold caps section names hung in an 11rem margin; bodies in the second column at a 68ch measure.
Underlines mark links and emphasis, as nroff marks italics.
Flat and square: no cards, shadows, gradients, radii or decorative icons.
One signature motion, the 200ms typeset/markdown crossfade.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means "this goes somewhere." If an element is blue and not a link (or the form accent), it is wrong.

rules.name: The Reverse Video Rule
rules.body: The only filled surfaces are ink blocks with paper text: the command submit, the pressed view toggle, the skip link, and selection. There is no tinted or grey surface anywhere.

rules.name: The Same-Size Head Rule
rules.body: Section heads are body size. Do not add heading sizes. The display line is the one exception, and there is only one per page.

rules.name: The Underline-Is-Italic Rule
rules.body: `em` is set upright with a 1px underline at 0.18em offset, as nroff renders italics. The italic face is loaded but the typeset view does not use it for emphasis.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Literal Rule
rules.body: Anything a reader would type, fetch or paste (commands, paths, filenames, URLs used as values) is set in Courier Prime and marked `translate="no"`.

rules.name: The Hanging Margin Rule
rules.body: Every section is a margin head plus an indented body. New content goes into a named section, not into a new layout.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, no tinted panels, no cards. If something needs separating, give it its own section or a hairline in Rule Grey.

dos: **Do** put every piece of content in a named section with a bold caps head in the 11rem margin and its body at a 68ch measure.
**Do** keep blue for links. Use reverse video (Ink fill, Paper text) for the one primary action and pressed states.
**Do** set anything literal (commands, paths, URLs) in Courier Prime with `translate="no"`.
**Do** make every component degrade to plain Markdown. Each MDX component needs a Markdown fallback, or `/index.md` breaks.
**Do** define every colour in both the paper and terminal palettes, and change nothing else for dark mode.
**Do** use the shared ease-out curve (cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)) at 160–200ms for state changes, and drop blur and scale under reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** add cards, shadows, gradients, rounded corners or tinted panels.
**Don't** add decorative or UI icons. The open-book logo mark is the only drawn glyph, and it appears as the brand mark (favicon, footer).
**Don't** add heading sizes. Section heads stay at body size, and the display size belongs to the NAME line alone.
**Don't** remove link underlines or use colour alone for emphasis. Emphasis is an underline.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue, including for error or success states.
**Don't** set body copy in Margin Grey. It is for the frame lines and placeholders.
